selection.baseline: Select the prompt by dev correct count, then fewer false_same cases, then declaration order.
selection.adaptation: Use the selected prompt and rank declared training candidates by dev correct count, then fewer false_same cases, then declaration order.
selection.cpu: Fit each of two fixed configurations on train. Select by dev correct count, then fewer false_same cases, then declaration order. Use a fixed probability threshold of 0.5.
selection.final: Freeze choices before either final set. Evaluate producer and receiver separately and use the identical base, prompt and decoder for the unadapted and adapted language model.

scoring.correct: The canonical label equals the source label. Invalid output counts as incorrect.
scoring.net_corrections: Adapted correct count minus unadapted correct count on the same rows.
scoring.false_same: Number of different pairs predicted same. False-positive rate is false_same divided by the number of different pairs.
scoring.cpu_gain: Adapted correct count minus the frozen CPU baseline correct count on the same rows.
scoring.report: Report per-class and paired results separately for both held-out sets. Claims apply to sampled PAWS-Wiki pairs.
